2609.24555.title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
2609.24555.paper_summary: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark for measuring mathematical progress from today's models toward artificial superintelligence through fourteen parameterised construction families. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at $1$. The families draw on open mathematical problems for long-term targets and generate new instances at larger parameters, where compact certificates keep large constructions verifiable. Across eight models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though no evaluated system surpasses a published frontier. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.
2609.24555.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了無盡考試，這是一個基準，用於衡量從當前模型到人工超智能的數學進步，通過十四個參數化的構建家族。每個提交的對象都會自動檢查其有效性，並根據已發表的前沿或構建基準分配相對質量分數，而不會將改進限制在 $1$。這些家族基於開放的數學問題作為長期目標，並在更大的參數下生成新的實例，其中緊湊的證明保持大型構建的可驗證性。在對 69 個不同實例進行評估的八個模型中，持續的質量分數區分了性能，儘管沒有評估的系統超越已發表的前沿。大小-質量曲線顯示隨著問題大小增加，構建質量如何變化。我們釋放生成器、驗證器、參考資料、模型響應和分析，以支持在超越人類前沿之前和之後的持續測量。
